title: Python Environments
motto: Dependency hell is real. Virtual environments are the cure.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Dependency hell is real. Virtual environments are the cure.

steps.title: One torch version per project
cards: Project A needs PyTorch 2.4 + CUDA 12.4. Project B pins 2.1 + CUDA 11.8. A global pip install breaks one of them every time.
Every project gets an isolated .venv with its own packages. Commit pyproject.toml + lockfile — never commit .venv/.

steps.title: uv, venv, conda
steps.body: uv is fastest for most work. venv ships with Python. conda when you need CUDA toolkits without system installs. Rule: don't mix pip and conda in the same env.

steps.title: Implement parse_requirement
steps.body: Parse a single requirements line like 'numpy>=1.26' or 'torch' into (name, min_version). min_version is None when unpinned.

artifact.name: Reproducible environments
artifact.description: You can create per-phase venvs, parse requirements, and avoid the global-install mistakes that break CUDA builds.
